channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: When Are Ethereum Gas Fees Lowest for Sui? Timing a Deposit
item.description: Ethereum gas fees are lowest when block demand is low; there is no reliable hour. Compare a live estimate with the Suibridge quote before signing.

item.title: RPC URLs in EVM network directories: who reviews them
item.description: Maintainers review RPC submissions before listing them; providers run the endpoints. Learn what Chainlist checks and what your wallet confirms.

item.title: Gnosis Chain Uses: Payments, DeFi and Low-Cost Validation
item.description: What is Gnosis Chain used for? It supports low-cost payments, DeFi, DAO tools and validating, with xDAI gas and a route in through Gnosis Bridge.

item.title: EU proposal targets 60 Russian banks and crypto networks
item.description: The European Commission proposed sanctions on Nov. 23 targeting 60 Russian banks and crypto networks, tightening financial pressure and barring Russian teams from EU sports.

item.title: Suibridge vs an Exchange Withdrawal When Gas Is High
item.description: Is it worth bridging a small amount to Sui when ETH gas is high? Usually not: compare the fixed deposit fee with your transfer, then wait or withdraw through an exchange.

item.title: DOJ seeks forfeiture of $1.1B in USDC tied to Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department filed a civil forfeiture claim for more than $1.1 billion in USDC tied to Binance’s October hack, while about $2.35 billion remains in linked wallets.

item.title: CFTC Clears Backpack and tZERO Derivatives Venues
item.description: The CFTC designated exchange operators for Backpack and tZERO and registered their clearing affiliates, opening a regulated route for new derivatives markets.

item.title: How to Borrow Stablecoins Against Bitcoin and Keep BTC
item.description: How to borrow stablecoins against Bitcoin in DeFi: wrap BTC as WBTC on Ethereum, supply it as collateral, and borrow DAI or USDS while tracking liquidation risk.

item.title: Block space in blockchain: How Ethereum prices each block
item.description: Block space in blockchain is the room each block has for transactions. On Ethereum, gas prices that capacity, while MEV makes transaction order valuable.

item.title: How to read a TronLink swap popup for beginners: sign or reject
item.description: Read a TronLink confirmation before signing a SunSwap swap by matching the contract address, function name, call value and fee limit to your intended…

item.title: renBTC vs WBTC: How Their Bitcoin Backing Works
item.description: RenBTC vs WBTC: both target Bitcoin’s value, but RenVM’s distributed minting and WBTC’s custodial reserves create different redemption paths and dependencies.

item.title: How Can a Same-Nonce Replacement Speed Up Ethereum?
item.description: To speed up a pending Ethereum transaction, use the same account and nonce with higher fee settings; review the replacement, sign it, then track confirmation.

item.title: Hong Kong bill targets four crypto services for SFC oversight
item.description: Hong Kong gazetted a bill on Nov. 20 to require virtual-asset dealers, advisers, managers and custodians to register or license with the SFC if enacted.

item.title: Chainflip halts services after $4.86 million vault drain
item.description: Chainflip paused Ethereum vault operations after a $4.86 million outflow, sending FLIP down more than 30% as investigators assess a valid but unusual signature.

item.title: Fake copycat tokens: How to verify before buying
item.description: How to spot fake copycat tokens with the same name: match the contract to the issuer’s official address, then compare its age, holders and liquidity.

item.title: US court authorizes seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance assets
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance assets, part of $2.7 billion frozen since October's theft.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2B in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says it has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, as efforts to trace funds continue.

item.title: How to buy an NFT on Polygon with ETH on Ethereum
item.description: How to buy an NFT on Polygon with ETH held on Ethereum: bridge ETH to Polygon PoS, get POL for gas, approve WETH and confirm the NFT in your wallet.

item.title: Isolation Mode vs E-Mode: Match the Mode to Your Collateral
item.description: Isolation mode vs E-Mode in DeFi lending: isolation caps approved borrowing against one asset; E-Mode raises LTV for correlated collateral and debt.

item.title: Liquidity pool swap prices: how quotes change
item.description: Liquidity pools set token swap prices from reserves and pricing curves; trade size changes execution, so your average price can differ from the ending spot price.
